lines.text: OK. Tell me about that day when you planned it. What was it, what did you talk about? What did you plan to do?

lines.text: 'bout what we were gonna do and that.

lines.text: Well ya, what were, tell me what the plan was. What were you gonna do? Do you understand what I mean? OK, when you make a plan was that like a list of things you're going to do for the day. Right? Is that what a plan is?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, so did you make some type of a list that you were gonna do that day? (pause) Come up with an idea?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Well what did you talk about with Steve a couple days prior to? (pause) Brendan what did you talk about? (pause) I can't hear you.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT

lines.text: Like how he was gonna do it and without someone seeing it.
